title: Shared Default migration and verified AliceProject selection

requirements.initial: Client startup preferences are legacy, conflicting or corrupt.
requirements.expected: One v3 authority is used; conflict opens selection and old files remain backups.

evidence.assertion: migrates consistent legacy choices once and ignores later backup changes, including new null
evidence.scope: Real temporary Supervisor filesystem and direct migration calls; no native clients.

evidence.assertion: uses both packaged and development Electron preferences regardless of which client migrates first
evidence.scope: Real temporary files at synthetic packaged/development Electron preference locations; no Electron process.

evidence.assertion: resolves explicit local and remote pairs without reading or persisting Default
evidence.scope: Temporary Supervisor root and direct resolver calls; explicit pairs and Home leave saved Default unchanged.

evidence.assertion: records a recoverable chooser state for %s without changing legacy data
evidence.scope: Real temporary filesystem; parameterized conflict/corrupt/unmapped legacy choices; no native chooser.

evidence.assertion: preserves unrelated config during concurrent settings and successful-selection writes
evidence.scope: Real temporary Supervisor filesystem; concurrent config writers, no native client.

evidence.assertion: serializes writes from independent CLI processes
evidence.scope: Real independent Node CLI subprocesses and temporary filesystem; no installed binary or native chooser.

evidence.assertion: loads a TUI-registered named home for explicit lifecycle commands
evidence.scope: Injected Supervisor registry/home check and Runtime inspection; verifies explicit CLI dispatch selection.

requirements.gap: Real Desktop/Web/TUI shared chooser startup and persistence across restart require separate native/browser acceptance.

requirements.initial: A Project connection is pending or a newer selection replaces it.
requirements.action: Verify identity, cancel/supersede, and remember successful selection.
requirements.expected: Only current verified selection commits; persistence failure is visible without losing attachment.

evidence.assertion: records Recent only after identity verification and keeps attachment if persistence fails
evidence.scope: Real loopback HTTP fixtures; injected startup writer.

evidence.assertion: does not let cancellation of an older request cancel its newer replacement
evidence.scope: Real local backend; controlled verification completions.

evidence.assertion: keeps an unavailable remote Default detached across healthy local polls
does not commit a cancelled, superseded, or closing connection after late verification
evidence.scope: Real loopback backend with controlled readiness completions; no native clients or SSH.

requirements.gap: Remote SSH and real browser chooser cancellation/restart not certified.

requirements.initial: Supervisor is launched in an isolated terminal with a selected Project or an unavailable Default.
requirements.action: Start, retry, choose a Project, and detach through the real PTY.
requirements.expected: Explicit overrides remain read-only; ordinary selection stays editable; failed Default never silently attaches local; detach restores terminal without stopping the Runtime.

evidence.assertion: keeps the session alive after Kitty Esc release and accepts bracketed command-search paste
evidence.scope: Real node-pty and terminal negotiation; fake lifecycle/relay; no installed binary.

evidence.assertion: shows a truthful Launch Flight Recorder while starting a local Runtime
evidence.scope: Real terminal, synthetic inspect/start/open boundary; no actual Runtime process.

evidence.assertion: recovers from a failed local launch through Retry-or-Back guidance
evidence.scope: Real terminal and injected failing startup, unchanged Runtime ownership.

evidence.assertion: shows CLI-selected AliceProjects as read-only instead of pretending to switch them
evidence.scope: Actual Node CLI subprocess and temporary Supervisor filesystem; no shipped binary.

evidence.assertion: creates, selects, remembers, and switches named AliceProjects inside the TUI
evidence.scope: Real terminal and config files, synthetic successful Runtime/relay verification.

evidence.assertion: keeps an unavailable remembered Default detached while the Project picker offers recovery
evidence.scope: Actual CLI subprocess, migrated temporary config, and failed real local verification. Invalid saved Default remains unchanged; no implicit successful attachment.

evidence.assertion: keeps internal presentation selection editable for Default %s
evidence.scope: Fake terminal/lifecycle with real temporary Supervisor config; null and non-default local saved selections preserve provenance and config.

evidence.assertion: keeps a missing Home unavailable while its Runtime endpoint is live
evidence.scope: Injected live inspection and unavailable local inventory; preserves distinct liveness and Home availability.

requirements.gap: Windows PTY, installed CLI, real SSH/native Runtime and shared Desktop/Web chooser acceptance remain separate. File selection runs all 60 PTY cases; these records claim only the named assertions.
